subject: Co-host: "Campfire" partner roundtable + blog swap (Catalyst)
messages:
From: Jamie Ortega <jamie@catalyst.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Invite to co-host a small partner roundtable (brief)

Hi Soojin,

Hope you’re well — we met briefly at the Vector Summit last spring. Catalyst is running a small ‘Campfire’ roundtable series next month: 45-minute, invite-only discussions with 5–8 senior platform/ML engineers focused on inference economics and integrating tooling partners. We’re aiming for intimate, technical conversations rather than product pitches.

Would Redwood be open to co-hosting one session? Our idea: 10–12 min context from Catalyst, 10 min Redwood product perspective, then 20 min guided discussion + 3 quick audience takeaways. We’d love to do a follow-up blog swap (one short recap post on each side) and promote the session to mutual customers.

Attached is a short one-pager + a draft agenda (campfire_agenda.pdf). Fee-wise, we typically cover the virtual platform and outreach; we also offer an optional small sponsorship to cover amplified promotion — happy to share details if you’re interested.

If that sounds interesting I can send a proposed date range and a short invite list.

Cheers,
Jamie Ortega
Head of Partnerships, Catalyst Labs
jamie@catalyst.io

Attachment: catalyst_onepager.pdf

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
To: Jamie Ortega <jamie@catalyst.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invite to co-host a small partner roundtable (brief)

Hi Jamie — great to hear from you and glad Catalyst is running this format. We’re definitely interested in co-hosting an intimate technical roundtable. A couple quick asks before we lock dates:

- Can you share the target attendee personas (titles/companies) you have in mind?
- Is there a preferred set of topics inside "inference economics" you want the hosts to prepare for (latency tuning, batching, model variants, billing transparency)?
- On the sponsorship/fees: can you send the promotion package and pricing?

Looping in Karthik (field eng lead) and Marissa (growth/events) to coordinate logistics and the blog swap. Karthik — can you skimmable-review the agenda and say if 12 minutes for Redwood technical is enough? Marissa — happy to own the co-branded recap post with Catalyst.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Jamie Ortega <jamie@catalyst.io>
Date: 2026-08-18T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invite to co-host a small partner roundtable (brief)

Soojin / Jamie — thanks for looping me in. Agenda looks good. 12 minutes for a Redwood demo/diff is tight but workable if we do a focused micro-case: 3 slides of context, 2-min live demo (embed + QPS example), and 5–6 min of best-practices for tuning/quantization tradeoffs.

Proposed talking points for Redwood slot:
- Quick customer problem: unpredictable token costs for chat-heavy workflows (30s)
- How smart batching + prefix cache reduced cost by X% on a production workload (1 min, quantitative bullet)
- Demo: live perf dashboard snippet + model variant fallback (2 min)
- 3 practical takeaways (3 min)

Marissa — for promotion, recommend we target: 3 PLG startups (product/platform lead), 2 mid-market SaaS infra teams, and 2 integrator/consultancy architects. Small list, invite-only.

I’ll prepare a pared-down deck if you want me to run a dry run.

— Karthik
Senior Field Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Jamie Ortega <jamie@catalyst.io>
Date: 2026-08-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invite to co-host a small partner roundtable (brief)

Jamie — love the format. Quick logistics and asks from Redwood marketing side:

- Proposed dates (Catalyst availability?): Aug 26–28 or Sept 2–4 (we prefer weekday afternoons PT).
- Promotion: we can do co-branded invite, a short 600–800 word post for the blog swap, and social amplification (X + LinkedIn). If Catalyst wants paid promotion, we recommend a $1,200 joint budget for one week of boosted posts.
- Assets we need: partner logo SVG, headshot for the host(s), and a 2–3 sentence summary for the invite.

I’m attaching our partner pricing sheet for reference (partner_pricing_sheet.xlsx). Once dates are locked, I’ll draft the co-branded invite and share a calendar hold.

Also: Karthik — yes please on a dry run. Can we schedule a 30-min run on Aug 24?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Growth Marketing, Redwood Inference

Attachment: partner_pricing_sheet.xlsx

From: Jamie Ortega <jamie@catalyst.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-08-19T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invite to co-host a small partner roundtable (brief)

Thanks all — this is great. We can do Aug 27 at 11:00 AM PT. Target attendee list will include: platform leads from 3 seed-to-series-A companies, 2 mid-market infra leads, and 1 systems integrator (Priya from ByteForge will be a guest speaker).

We’ll send the invite list today; attached is the short promo one-pager (catalyst_onepager.pdf). Sponsorship: we’ll waive any fee for Redwood for this first co-hosted session and just ask you to uplift promotion.

Priya — can you confirm you’re available on Aug 27 and whether you want 5–7 minutes for a short mention of ByteForge’s inference connectors?

Jamie

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.inference>
To: Jamie Ortega <jamie@catalyst.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Priya Singh <priya@byteforge.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T16:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Invite to co-host: final logistics + deliverables

Perfect — Aug 27 at 11:00 AM PT works for Redwood. Quick checklist and next steps from our side:

- Marissa will draft co-branded invite and share by Aug 21 end-of-day.
- Karthik will prepare a 6-slide micro-deck and join a dry run on Aug 24 (30-min).
- Jamie / Catalyst: please send final attendee list and any compliance or recording preferences (we can record for invite-only distribution if you’re comfortable).
- Marketing deliverables: blog swap (600–800 words each) due Sept 3; social copy due Aug 25.

Attachment: campfire_agenda.pdf (finalized agenda)

Looking forward — I’ll send a calendar invite after Marissa shares the co-branded copy.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.inference
